text: Remvu 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地项目记忆插件，通过 DSH 原生工具和 agent/pre-step 上下文钩子接入独立 Remvu 引擎。它提供保存交接、恢复项目背景、检查记忆与代码新鲜度、浏览近期事件以及按 ID 查看证据等功能；可选记录直接用户消息和工具结果，并在会话开始或压缩后恢复一次上下文。适合在不同编码 agent 或 DSH 会话之间延续项目工作。使用前需要安装 Remvu 独立程序并初始化项目；自动记录默认关闭，不需要额外 API 密钥。

Remvu adds local project memory to DeepSeek Harness. Native tools save handoffs, resume context, check freshness, browse events, and inspect evidence. Optional recording stores user messages and tool results locally. Initialize the project with the standalone app; recording is off by default.
我想把项目目标和未完成事项保存下来，换个 DSH 会话继续做。
让新的编码 agent 能读到这个项目之前的交接背景。
DSH 能不能帮我检查保存的项目记忆和代码状态是否仍然匹配？
我需要查看某条历史工具结果的详细证据。
Help me carry project context and open work into a fresh DSH session.
I want to review saved evidence and see whether it is still current for this codebase.
Remvu 的功能「保存项目交接」：通过 remvu_save 工具保存私有项目交接。可提交经过审阅的提案，也可导出已有状态；工具描述要求先查看相关记忆证据。
Remvu 的功能「恢复上下文」：会话开始或压缩后，agent/pre-step 钩子调用本地引擎恢复项目记忆，并将结果作为上下文消息加入当前会话。
Remvu 的功能「查看记忆证据」：可调用 remvu_events 浏览事件，并用 remvu_show 按 ID 查看证据；remvu_check 用于检查记忆状态与代码新鲜度。
Remvu 的使用前须知：自动记录和上下文注入默认关闭；启用后才会将符合条件的本地用户消息及工具结果交给项目中的独立引擎记录。
切换编码工具时，怎样带上已确认的决定和约束？
Can I keep a local record of project observations and retrieve them later?
dsh-remvu 提供命令 codex
dsh-remvu 提供命令 claude

dsh-remvu README · Remvu：Remvu keeps goals, constraints, rejected approaches, unfinished work and check evidence alongside your project. The complete standalone engine bundles its runtime: **users do not install Python**. Opt-in observable recording, code fingerprints, concurrent updates, recovery and private sharing boundaries remain part of the engine.

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](docs/quickstart.md) · [DeepSeek Harness plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md) · [Evidence and limits](docs/standalone.md)

dsh-remvu README · Remvu：Fresh installations create no hooks. Recording is a separate choice; fingerprints, CAS protection and recovery stay available in manual mode. Resume reads a short preview; details are fetched only when needed.

dsh-remvu README · Try the complete app：> Install the complete Remvu standalone candidate from https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu for my OS and architecture. Verify its checksum, extract the entire application folder, then run its install command for this project. Preserve existing settings and memory. Install save/resume without hooks. Enable recording only if I ask; explain any required client trust once. Do not install a system Python or substitute the notes-only fallback.

dsh-remvu README · Try the complete app：The v0.3.0-beta.3 application is a test candidate. CI produces platform archives; a production release and the full native-client support matrix remain gated on actual acceptance. See [the build and installation guide](docs/standalone.md) for available artifacts, verification and exact steps. Git is still required. macOS distribution signing/notarization is not configured.

dsh-remvu README · Try the complete app：| Everyday action | Claude Code | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save a private handoff | `/remvu save` | `$remvu save` |
| Continue in a new session | `/remvu resume` | `$remvu resume` |

dsh-remvu README · Try the complete app：`save` asks the current agent to consolidate reviewed evidence and exports `.remvu/handoff/REMVU.md`. A direct program invocation without a proposal exports existing state and leaves pending evidence pending. It never uploads or commits. `resume` checks the saved code state before continuing. The receiver can also read the handoff alongside the code without installing Remvu.

dsh-remvu README · Try the complete app：Save while the original agent can still respond. Automatic logs retain observations; they cannot recover an exhausted agent's unwritten understanding. Stop hooks do not block completion or force another model turn.

dsh-remvu README · A handoff in 30 seconds：1. In Claude Code, ask `/remvu save`.
2. Open the project in Codex and ask `$remvu resume`.
3. Review the next step and any stale checks, pending evidence or conflicts, then continue.

dsh-remvu README · A handoff in 30 seconds：This describes the workflow, not a measured completion-time guarantee. [Earlier real handoff trials](docs/validation-report.md) and the [10-task notes-only comparison](docs/product-validation.md) are published with their limits. The latter found no first-pass accuracy advantage over ordinary HANDOFF notes; it does not measure the new standalone app or prove token savings.

dsh-remvu README · DeepSeek Harness：The `dsh-remvu` bundle adds five native tools and observable event recording to DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**. It uses the same standalone engine and `.remvu/` state. The JavaScript package needs no compilation or install-time build script. [Install the plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md).

dsh-remvu README · DeepSeek Harness：The plugin was installed through the official `dsh plugin add` flow and loaded in a real isolated SDK profile without a model request. Model-driven handoff and GUI acceptance are separate pending checks. Local projects only; it does not claim cloud or remote-filesystem support.

dsh-remvu README · What stays in memory：Claims distinguish `user_confirmed`, `observed`, `inferred` and `unverified`. Rejected decisions and superseded history survive. Check results retain the code fingerprint they actually tested; later edits make those checks historical. Concurrent proposals cannot silently overwrite newer memory.

dsh-remvu README · What stays in memory：Private memory and detailed evidence stay in ignored `.remvu/`. Public `REMVU.md` is generated only on an explicit share request, with public inline evidence and patch review. Hidden reasoning, credentials and unrelated conversations are excluded. `doctor`, `repair`, upgrades, rollback and uninstall remain available when needed; uninstall retains private memory.

dsh-remvu README · For multi-model platforms and API relay services：“换模型、换客户端，把项目背景一起带走。” A platform that can observe local project changes and tool outcomes can embed the memory engine or build an adapter. Pure API forwarding has no complete view of the project and cannot promise full operation records. The DSH adapter is a concrete local-host integration; no generic relay integration or measured savings percentage is claimed.
section: For multi-model platforms and API relay services

Source developers can still run the standard-library Python engine. Neither path replaces the complete standalone app.

[Open format](spec/README.md) · [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [License](LICENSE). Existing `remvu/1` documents and legacy evidence import remain supported.

dsh-remvu README · Remvu：Claude Code 额度快用完时保存，换到 Codex 继续做。

Remvu 把项目目标、约束、被否决的方案、未完成事项和检查依据留在项目里。完整独立程序自带运行环境，**用户不用安装 Python**，自动记录、代码指纹、并发保护、损坏恢复和分享隔离均保留。

[English](README.md) · [安装](docs/quickstart.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness 插件](adapters/dsh/README.md) · [验证与限制](docs/standalone.md)

默认安装没有钩子。需要时再单独开启自动记录；代码指纹、并发保护和恢复仍可使用。接手先读短摘要，详细证据按需展开，不在每轮重复整理。

dsh-remvu README · 交给 agent 安装：> 从 https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu 为我的系统和架构安装完整 Remvu 独立程序候选版。校验下载包，解压整个程序文件夹，再为当前项目安装。保留已有配置与记忆，默认只安装保存和接手，不启用钩子。只有我要求自动记录时再开启，并一次说明需要我完成的客户端信任步骤。不要安装系统 Python，也不要换成仅笔记版。

v0.3.0-beta.3 仍是测试候选版。CI 生成各平台程序包；正式发布与客户端支持范围需要逐项真实验收。下载和校验方法见[独立程序说明](docs/standalone.md)。仍需 Git，macOS 分发签名和公证尚未配置。

| 日常操作 | Claude Code | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 保存本地交接 | `/remvu save` | `$remvu save` |
| 新会话接手 | `/remvu resume` | `$remvu resume` |

dsh-remvu README · 交给 agent 安装：`save` 让当前 agent 整理已审阅的证据，生成私有 `.remvu/handoff/REMVU.md`。直接运行程序而不提交整理内容时，只导出现有状态，待整理记录仍保留。保存不会提交代码或上传文件。接收方只拿代码和交接文件也能继续，无需安装 Remvu。

在原 agent 还能响应时保存。自动日志能留下操作事实，无法补出额度耗尽后未写下的理解。Stop hook 不阻塞结束，也不强迫模型再跑一轮。

dsh-remvu README · 30 秒了解交接流程：1. 在 Claude Code 中调用 `/remvu save`。
2. 用 Codex 打开项目，调用 `$remvu resume`。
3. 核对下一步、过期检查、待整理证据和冲突，继续任务。

这是流程说明，不是完成时间保证。[早期真实接手记录](docs/validation-report.md)和[十任务仅笔记对照实验](docs/product-validation.md)均保留原始结论与限制。后者未显示比普通 HANDOFF 笔记更高的首轮准确率，也没有测量本次独立程序或证明 token 节省。

dsh-remvu README · DeepSeek Harness 插件：`dsh-remvu` 为 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** 提供五个原生工具和可观察事件记录，使用同一套独立引擎与本地记忆。插件已经写成 JavaScript，安装无需编译或执行构建脚本。[安装说明](adapters/dsh/README.md)。

已通过官方插件安装流程，并在隔离的真实 SDK 配置中加载；验证过程未请求模型。真实模型接手和 GUI 验收仍待完成。当前适配本地项目，不宣称远程文件系统或云端执行兼容。

dsh-remvu README · 保留完整功能：记忆区分用户确认、工具观察、agent 推断和待核实内容。旧决定与被否决方向保留历史。检查结果绑定当时的代码指纹，代码变化后不能沿用旧的“通过”。并发提案需核对版本，不能静默覆盖另一方记录。

本地记忆与详细证据留在忽略的 `.remvu/`。只有显式分享才生成公开 `REMVU.md`，公开依据需能独立阅读，未提交补丁需单独审阅。隐藏思考链、凭据和无关对话不导出。排错、恢复、升级、回滚、卸载等能力仍在，卸载保留私人记忆。

dsh-remvu README · 面向多模型平台与 API 中转站：换模型、换客户端，把项目背景一起带走。能观察本地项目改动和工具结果的平台，可嵌入记忆引擎或编写适配器。纯 API 转发无法完整看到项目操作，不能承诺完整记录。DSH 是已有的本地主机适配，尚无通用中转站集成或节省比例的实测结论。

需要更轻的路径时，可主动选择[仅笔记备用版](skills/remvu/assets/markdown-skill.md)；开发者也可继续运行标准库 Python 源码。完整独立程序是本轮主交付。

[开放格式](spec/README.md) · [兼容状态](docs/compatibility.md) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [MIT 许可](LICENSE)。继续支持 `remvu/1` 和旧证据格式导入。
section: 面向多模型平台与 API 中转站
